title: thelypteris illicita
intro: Thelypteris illicita, commonly known as the illicit maidenhair fern, is a species of fern in the family Thelypteridaceae. It is a medicinal plant used to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and inflammation, due to its health benefits such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Thelypteris illicita include analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antipyretic effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents like flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids. However, further research is needed to fully understand the extent of its health benefits and therapeutic actions.
